name: Russia

system.type: Two-round direct presidential vote; Duma: 225 list-PR (5% threshold) + 225 single-member seats

wildFacts.text: Officially reported (TASS/CEC): more than 7 million people voted online in the 2026 Duma election.
The monitor Golos reported voters being made to prove how they voted with photos, screenshots or geolocation.
Russia did not invite OSCE/ODIHR observers to the 2024 presidential election.

notes: Presidential figures are officially reported (CEC, via Interfax): turnout 77.49%. Reuters 77.4 / 77.44 was the preliminary figure. 2026 Duma (18-20 Sep 2026): officially reported turnout 59.8%, United Russia won the party-list vote (TASS). Duma seat counts are not shown because they could not be confirmed. The map shows the country as a whole.
